mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.member_id, o.item_amount, o.discount_amount, o.payable_amount, o.point_deduct_amount, o.received_amount, o.change_amount, o.status, o.remark, o.create_time, o.paid_time, m.name AS member_name, m.phone AS member_phone, s.name AS store_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) FROM salon_refund_order r WHERE r.order_id = o.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1) AS refunded_amount FROM salon_order o LEFT JOIN salon_member m ON m.id = o.member_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN salon_store s ON s.id = o.store_id AND s.deleted = 0
